description: This file defines the 'PolicyEntryModificationInvalidException' class, a custom exception used in the Eclipse Ditto framework to indicate that a policy entry modification has led to an invalid policy state. The class includes methods for creating instances from message strings, JSON objects, and headers, and contains a nested builder class for constructing exception instances with customized details.

classes.name: PolicyEntryModificationInvalidException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating an invalid modification of a policy entry, with static methods for creation from messages, JSON, and headers, and a nested builder class.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: Inner static class providing a fluent API to build instances of PolicyEntryModificationInvalidException with customizable message, description, cause, headers, and hyperlink.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new Builder instance initialized with the provided PolicyId and label.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an exception instance with a given message and headers.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an exception instance with a message, optional description, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a JSON object and headers, parsing the error message contained.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with the specified DittoHeaders, copying other properties from the current instance.
